title: Antennapod Metric0 Hour-of-Day Pattern
dataSources: AntennaPod episodes (`antennapod:episode`), Audible listening sessions (`audible:listen`), Goodreads audiobooks (`goodreads:audiobook`), podcast queues (`podcast:queue`), and listening streaks (`listen:streak`).
app: AntennaPod listening exports, Audible progress logs, Goodreads audiobook shelves, podcast queue snapshots, and listening streak counters ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=antennapod:metric0
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour source_id
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day antennapod metric0 events most often occur for each source.
value: Hour-of-day patterns reveal routine anchors, timezone drift, and automation misfires.
implementation: Extract hour from `_time` on antennapod metric0 events and chart counts by source.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of events by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It brings back what time of day your antennapod metric0 feed is busiest and when it goes quiet.
